originalTitle: Amazon’s AI assistant can now spot fake emails from the company
summary: Amazon is trying to combat impersonation scams with a new feature that allows you to use its AI assistant to determine whether an email, text message, or phone call actually came from the company. content: Amazon is trying to combat impersonation scams with a new feature that allows you to use its AI assistant to determine whether an email, text message, or phone call actually came from the company. With the update, you can ask Alexa for Shopping about a message you received, and it will use AI to compare it “against a record of every message Amazon has sent,” while also analyzing its contents, formatting, and the sender. As noted by Amazon, the assistant will only confirm that a message is real if it’s “completely certain.” An example shared by Amazon shows a customer asking, “Did Amazon just text me an OTP from 98626? Message came around 4:50pm.” Alexa for Shopping responds by confirming that Amazon actually did send the message, saying, “This was a genuine One Time Password from Amazon.” [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/alexa-for-shopping.gif?quality=90&strip=all] If Alexa for Shopping determines a message isn’t from Amazon, it will instruct customers to check their orders in the app and contact Amazon’s support team directly. The company launched a similar feature earlier this year that lets you forward suspicious messages to “verify@amazon.com” to check if they’re real. This isn’t the only recent update Amazon has launched for Alexa for Shopping, as it added an “Update Me When” feature that can now help you track new product releases as well.
chineseTitle: 亚马逊的 AI 助手现在可以识别来自该公司的虚假电子邮件
chineseSummary: 亚马逊正试图通过一项新功能来打击假冒诈骗，该功能允许您使用其人工智能助手来确定电子邮件、短信或电话是否确实来自该公司。通过更新，您可以向 Alexa for Shopping 询问您收到的消息，它将使用 AI 来比较 [...]
chineseContent: 亚马逊正试图通过一项新功能来打击假冒诈骗，该功能允许您使用其人工智能助手来确定电子邮件、短信或电话是否确实来自该公司。通过更新，您可以向 Alexa for Shopping 询问您收到的消息，它将使用人工智能将其“与亚马逊发送的每条消息的记录”进行比较，同时还分析其内容、格式和发件人。正如亚马逊所指出的，只有在“完全确定”的情况下，助手才会确认消息的真实性。亚马逊分享的一个例子显示，一位顾客问道：“亚马逊刚刚给我发了一条来自 98626 的 OTP 短信吗？消息是在下午 4:50 左右收到的。” Alexa for Shopping 做出回应，确认亚马逊确实发送了该消息，并表示：“这是来自亚马逊的真正的一次性密码。” [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/alexa-for-shopping.gif?quality=90&strip=all] 如果 Alexa for Shopping 确定消息不是来自亚马逊，它将指示客户在应用程序中检查订单并直接联系亚马逊的支持团队。该公司今年早些时候推出了类似的功能，可以让您将可疑消息转发到“verify@amazon.com”以检查它们是否真实。这并不是亚马逊最近为 Alexa for Shopping 推出的唯一更新，因为它添加了“Update Me When”功能，现在也可以帮助您跟踪新产品发布。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
